day_shape: 78 items: IRGC says two tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, IDF confirms killing Hamas northern Gaza internal-security chief Muhammad Abu al-Awf, Trump says the Iran war is 'funded' through January and regime change 'probably doable', Huawei convicted in US court on Iran-sanctions charges, UK commits £14m to UK-Med in Gaza.

threads.label: Tanker explosions in Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: The IRGC Navy and Iranian Army said two tankers struck sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz early Wednesday, exploding and catching fire, with Defa Press publishing video. Jerusalem Post relayed the Iranian account; army spokesman Akramini-nia said stricter control would be applied to the strait.

threads.label: IDF kills Hamas internal security chief
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed killing Muhammad Abu al-Awf, 47, director of Hamas internal security in northern Gaza, in an overnight strike on Shati camp that Hamas said also killed his wife and two daughters. The military said Abu al-Awf belonged to a 'secret circle' that held the body of Staff Sgt. Oron Shaul.

threads.label: Trump on Iran war funding and regime change
threads.summary: Trump said the war against Iran is 'funded' through January and that toppling the Islamic Republic is 'probably doable' but not his objective, while claiming Iran had 'little capacity to fire missiles'. Defence Minister Israel Katz said Iran is 'in the process of developing chemical weapons'; a former IAF air-defence commander said Israel could strike alone but was unlikely to act without US approval.

threads.label: Huawei convicted on Iran sanctions
threads.summary: A US federal jury convicted Huawei of espionage-related charges and violating Iran sanctions, with prosecutors alleging it misled banks about its Iran business and helped Tehran build internet censorship tools. Iran International reported company records showing Huawei equipment continued flowing into Iranian networks.

threads.label: Houthi–Saudi exchanges and Red Sea
threads.summary: Houthi forces threatened to target Jeddah and all Saudi Red Sea ports if Riyadh strikes Hodeidah, as Saudi Arabia struck Houthi sites across Yemen and the UK added sanctions and defensive support. Secretary Rubio spoke with Saudi FM Prince Faisal, condemning Houthi attacks and stressing freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb.

threads.label: Basij Week messaging from Iranian state
threads.summary: Defa Press, IRIB and Khamenei's office pushed a heavy Basij Week cycle, with the armed forces chief of staff, defence minister and Basij deputy claiming one million people will receive military training across 1,500 neighbourhoods. Khamenei's office said population growth and family policy were a 'strategic and fateful' pillar of a 'stronger Iran'.

threads.label: UK and UN Gaza/Lebanon humanitarian track
threads.summary: The FCDO announced £14 million for UK-Med to deliver emergency treatment, surgery and rehabilitation in Gaza, and a second group of sick and injured Gazan children arrived in the UK for NHS care. The UN spokesperson reported 433 instances of Israeli artillery and mortar fire and 130 airspace violations in south Lebanon from 19–23 November.

events.title: A senior commander in Hamas's internal security apparatus was killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza City overnight, according to the terror group. Hamas's interior ministry says the strike on the Shati camp killed Muhammad Abu al-Awf, 47, director of internal security in the northern Gaza Strip, along with his wife and two teenage daughters. The IDF has not yet commented on the strike, which comes a day after the chief of the internal security apparatus, Naim Abu Nahal, was killed in an Israeli strike.
events.summary:

The IDF has not yet commented on the strike, which comes a day after the chief of the internal security apparatus, Naim Abu Nahal, was killed in an Israeli strike.— Emanuel (Mannie) Fabian (@manniefabian) Nov 25, 2026

According to the report, the case is based on violation of the law on boycotting the Israeli enemy, as the content of the episode constitutes, in the view of the complainant, a clear breach of this law.

events.title_en: A strategic and fateful issue: Among the components of power, progress and achieving a stronger Iran, the issue of increasing the population of dear Iran while preserving all desirable quantitative and qualitative aspects is considered among the most important.
events.summary_en: A strategic and fateful issue: Among the components of power, progress and achieving a stronger Iran, the issue of increasing the population of dear Iran while preserving all desirable quantitative and qualitative aspects is considered among the most important. This strategic and fateful issue, which has been repeatedly emphasised in recent decades by the great leader, the late Imam Khomeini, may God elevate his station, is effective both in actualising capabilities and in creating and promoting multiple scientific, cultural, economic and social opportunities, and in repelling and removing threats and malice from enemies.
